sentences.text:
Sheikh Irshad Mansoori vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15
March, 2024
Author: Vishal Dhagat

Bench: Vishal Dhagat
In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur Cra No. 4065 of 2022 (Sheikh
Irshad Mansoori Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) Dated : 15-03-2024 Shri Ravi
Mahendra Kumar Vyas - Advocate for appellant.

entities.text: High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Narendra Chourasiya - Govt. Advocate for the State.

Shri Chandra Prakash Patel - Advocate for
objector.
Heard on I.A. No.3789/2024, an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.

2. Appellant has been convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 366 and 376(1)(n) of the IPC and sentenced to undergo for period of five years RI and RI for ten years with fine of Rs.1500/-
with default stipulation.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the appellant submitted that appellant is in jail since last two years.
He is a young boy of 25 years.
There is compromise between the appellant and prosecutrix.
Offence is not compoundable but in view of compromise between the parties, Court may consider his plea for reducing the sentence.
In these circumstances, sentence may be suspended and he be granted bail.
4. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the State has opposed the application for suspension of sentence.
5. Learned counsel appearing for prosecutrix submits that he has filed Vakalatnama on her behalf and compromise has been taken place between the parties.

6. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
7.
Considering the compromise and custody period of appellant, I.A. is allowed.

8. It is directed that remaining part of the substantive jail sentence imposed upon the appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of this appeal and appellant shall be released on bail, on his depositing the entire amount of fine, if not already deposited, and on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 28/05/2024 and all other subsequent dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard.
